data.name: Leonian
data.gender_notes: Leonian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'leon', meaning lion. In the Bible, the name Leon is given to several figures, including a prince of Judah (Genesis 30:4-7) and a high priest of the Temple (1 Maccabees 2:29). The lion is a symbol of power, courage, and royalty in both Greek and biblical cultures. The name Leonian carries the meaning “Lion-like” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leonian usually hope their child will grow to embody lion-like and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, strength, and royalty in Christian tradition.
data.etymology: Leonian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion-like.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leonian total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: ליאונאן
in_hebrew.meaning: השפעה של אריה לב כוחניות ואומץ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ליאונאן הוא שילוב של השמות ליאו ואנן, המתורגמים ל'לב אריה' או 'כוח אריה'. הוא שייך למסורת הנוצרית ומבטא תכונות של כוח, אומץ וגבורה. השם מורכב מהמילה העברית 'לב' שפירושה לב, ומ'נ' המסמלת נצחון או תוספת כוח.

in_greek.name: Λεωνιαν
in_greek.meaning: Το ισχυρόν και γενναίον του Λέων
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Λεωνιαν προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'του Λέων' ή 'που ανήκει στον Λέων'. Ο Λέων είναι σύμβολο δύναμης και γενναιότητας, επομένως το όνομα Λεωνιαν αντιπροσωπεύει αυτά τα χαρακτηριστικά. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα συνδέεται με την πνευματική δύναμη και την ανδρεία των πιστών.

in_latin.name: Leonian

in_latin.long_meaning: The name Leonian originates from the Latin term 'Leo', signifying 'lion'. It embodies the qualities of courage, strength, and valor. Historically, the name has been associated with individuals of great fortitude and spiritual resilience. In Christian tradition, Leonian symbolizes the heart of a lion, representing bravery and steadfast faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Leonian in Christian tradition evokes images of courage and royalty, similar to the ancient Greek association of the lion as a noble and powerful creature. It is a name befitting individuals with strong wills and a fierce determination to succeed.
data.spiritual_significance: In a more spiritual sense, the name Leonian can represent the strength and courage of a soul striving to follow God's will despite the challenges and adversities of life. It can also symbolize the hope and faith that God is always with us, a mighty and powerful companion in our spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Leonian symbolically represents strength and courage, as a lion is a powerful and fearless animal. Spiritually, it signifies an individual deeply connected to the divine, embodying the lion's courage and roaring faith in God.
